summary.zh: 运行信息胶囊新增「环境信息」卡：一眼查看工作台 Git 变更与分支，支持切换分支、提交、提交并推送与直接推送，提交信息可由 AI 生成（标题+正文）。新增源代码管理图表风格的提交历史泳道图，提交 ID 一键复制，悬浮提示全面升级为应用统一样式。同时修复工具调用契约的路径不变量问题。
summary.en: The runtime info capsule gains an Environment card: inspect workspace git changes and branch at a glance, switch branches, commit, commit-and-push or push directly, with AI-generated commit messages (title plus body). A source-control-graph style commit history with swimlanes is included, commit IDs copy on click, and hover tips now use the unified in-app tooltip. Also fixes route-invariant tool contract execution.

title.zh: 环境信息卡：工作台 Git 状态与操作
title.en: Environment card: workspace git status and actions

summary.zh: 运行信息胶囊内新增「环境信息」卡，显示当前工作台的未提交变更（行级增删合计与逐文件 diff）、本地/分支工作树与当前分支；支持弹层列出全部分支并一键切换，提交弹窗提供提交、提交并推送与直接推送，提交信息留空可由 AI 按标题+正文格式生成，非 Git 目录自动降级。
summary.en: A new Environment card inside the runtime info capsule shows uncommitted changes (line totals plus per-file diffs), the local or branch worktree, and the current branch. A popover lists all branches for one-click switching, the commit dialog offers commit, commit-and-push and push-only, and an empty commit message can be auto-generated by AI in title-plus-body form. Non-git workspaces degrade gracefully.

details.zh: 变更弹窗点击文件即可行内展开行级 diff，未跟踪的新文件以全新增补丁呈现。
details.en: Clicking a file in the changes dialog expands an inline line-level diff; untracked new files appear as all-added patches.

sources.title: 新增运行信息胶囊 Git 环境信息卡及全栈实现
feat(desktop): 环境信息卡可折叠并新增提交历史泳道图；悬浮提示自研化与哈希点击复制

title.zh: 提交历史泳道图与提交 ID 一键复制
title.en: Commit history swimlane graph with one-click commit ID copy

summary.zh: 新增源代码管理图表风格的提交历史视图：泳道图形呈现分支合并轨迹，头部提交高亮，附 refs 徽标、作者与相对时间；短哈希悬停查看完整提交信息，点击即复制完整提交 ID。
summary.en: A new source-control-graph style history view renders branch merges as swimlanes with the HEAD commit highlighted, plus ref chips, author and relative time. Hovering a short hash previews the full message and clicking copies the full commit ID.

sources.title: feat(desktop): 环境信息卡可折叠并新增提交历史泳道图；悬浮提示自研化与哈希点击复制

title.zh: 修复工具调用契约的路径不变量

summary.zh: 工具调用契约执行改为与路由无关的不变量，规范会话路径归一，并补齐 Windows 路径夹具与最终契约校验，避免同一工具在不同调用路径下行为漂移。
summary.en: Tool contract execution now enforces route invariance with normalized session paths, plus Windows path fixtures and final contract validation, so a tool behaves identically regardless of invocation route.

title.zh: 补齐繁体/日/韩缺失文案

summary.zh: 补齐繁体中文、日文与韩文缺失的技能面板与项目技能文案键，五种语言与英文键位完全对齐。
summary.en: Missing skill panel and project skill entries for Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean were added; all five locales now match the English key set.

sources.title: fix(test): 合并主线后收口——i18n 补键、持久化指纹与 CLI closure 重算、样式基线收账

title.zh: 悬浮提示统一为应用内样式

summary.zh: Git 相关悬浮提示不再依赖系统原生 title，统一使用应用自带 Tooltip：延迟可控、跟随主题，悬停即可查看完整提交信息、完整路径与完整哈希。
summary.en: Git-related hover tips no longer rely on the OS-native title; they use the in-app tooltip with controlled delay and theme support, revealing the full commit message, full paths and full hashes on hover.

sources.title: feat(desktop): 环境信息卡可折叠并新增提交历史泳道图；悬浮提示自研化与哈希点击复制
